loop: log --- brazier over magma melts honeycomb into bone wax
cmd item replace entity @a hotbar.8 with votum:seal_brazier
assert votum:seal_brazier placed | execute if block 60 -60 50 votum:seal_brazier
assert honeycomb in | execute if block 60 -60 50 votum:seal_brazier[fill=1]
assert wax melting | execute if block 60 -60 50 votum:seal_brazier[fill=2]
expectinv four bone wax poured | votum:sealing_wax | 4
assert brazier empty | execute if block 60 -60 50 votum:seal_brazier[fill=0]
log --- desk seals a Grave Watch warrant with the skull signet
cmd item replace entity @a hotbar.8 with votum:signet_desk
assert votum:signet_desk placed | execute if block 63 -60 50 votum:signet_desk
assert wax slot 0 | execute if items entity @a hotbar.0 votum:sealing_wax
assert blank warrant on the desk | execute unless items entity @a container.* votum:blank_warrant
assert sealed warrant made | execute if items entity @a container.* votum:sealed_warrant[votum:pact="votum:grave_watch"]
expectinv unused wax handed back | votum:sealing_wax | 3
assert sealed warrant in slot 1 | execute if items entity @a hotbar.1 votum:sealed_warrant
assert warrant sworn and spent | execute unless items entity @a container.* votum:sealed_warrant
log --- kill undead by hand until 25 count
cmd item replace entity @a hotbar.8 with minecraft:iron_sword
assert oath kept, fulfilled warrant given | execute if items entity @a container.* votum:fulfilled_warrant[votum:pact="votum:grave_watch"]
log --- the fulfilled warrant presses a signet ring
